dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical geometric narrowing of the dorsal plane from the mid-body toward the posterior visible limit.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High frequency of small, light-toned speckles distributed across the central and lateral dorsal surfaces.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary dark-grey skin and the lighter speckling.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One distinct dark-pigmented circular mark located on the mid-upper dorsal axis; numerous small, high-contrast light points scattered across the dorsal plane.
